Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.18 replaces five narration/ending CG images with 1664x936 high-resolution exports and uses bilinear filtering for those artworks while keeping the pixel-art attendant, harem and revolution ending CGs point-filtered. It also makes the maid v2 post-story visits follow the previous visit's day, so the gala's "back at work tomorrow" line no longer leads into a week with no story. The 1.17 cross-mod compatibility, 1.16 gala portrait fix, 1.15 two-person speaker/harem date fixes, 1.14 game-version policy and earlier fixes remain. Simplified Chinese / English. 1.18 将五张剧情/结局 CG 替换为 1664x936 高清导出，并对这些图启用双线性过滤；侍从、后宫和革命军的像素风结局 CG 继续保持最近邻。侍从线 v2 后日谈改为按上一次来访日期相对排期，不再在“明天照常来上工”之后空转一周。保留 1.17 跨 MOD 兼容、1.16 晚会立绘修复、1.15 双人演出名字与后宫约会日修复、1.14 游戏版本策略及更早修复。简体中文 / English。
